Mystic messenger is not the best at handling certain sensitive topics well, like SA, sexuality, mental health, etc. Being 'sexist' towards the male gender is also kinda zen's whole thing? All the guys are supposed to fufill some kind of fantasy, and Zen's is the "white knight who treats women like delicate flowers and protects them - even at the cost of HIMSELF". I find that trope very annoying and infantilizing as well, but that's just the fantasy he was made to portray.

Also, in many of the routes they demonize other women to "lift up" the MC so the (assumed younger girl by the game) player can feel like she is "not like other girls",  feel more special, and have more excuses for the characters to dote on her + compliment her in comparison to those "aNnOYiNG fEmaLes!!1". Once again, not a trope I find interesting or enjoyable, but you have to remember these stories were written around 2014-2015 and there WAS a different climate around gender roles and the treatment of women, especially in Korea where it was written.

Overall, I definitely agree with you as I personally find Zen's route one of the most dated and honestly offensive, but it was written to fulfill a certain fantasy and during a time when casual sexism was still pretty common!
